| A role without the right tries the read or the match | Refused, nothing changes | MSG-P4-002 |
| The proceeds reference is unknown or out of the caller's scope | One problem document, no change | HTTP 404 |
| The receipt is already matched and a second match is posted under a new key | Refused, the stored answer is not overwritten | HTTP 409 |
| A required element of the match is missing or invalid | Refused, nothing changes | MSG-GEN-001; HTTP 422 |
| A consumed read does not answer inside 2 s | The run stops for that receipt and retries; the breaker opens per downstream | HTTP 503; ADR-020 |
| The same business date is run twice | No second row and no second event; the repeat is counted | R-UNI-40 |
| A receipt resolves to no case | No matched row; the receipt is reported unmatched on SCR-28 | R-LIT-72; `matched_to` UNMATCHED |
| A receipt on no open case at all | Held on the exception list of the matching family, which is RWB-P8-E2008-APP's behaviour, not a new row here | FSD P8 AC-EXC-P8-001-02 |
